description: Unit tests for the PointerSet class, testing construction, modification, and set operations.

classes.name: PointerSet
classes.description: A set data structure for pointers, supporting add, erase, insert, intersection, and conversion to vector.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a pointer to the set, returns true if inserted.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a pointer from the set, returns true if erased.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts elements from a range or another set.

methods.name: intersection_with
methods.description: Returns a new set that is the intersection with another set.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Converts the set to a vector of pointers.
